scope: 24 replacement street grates; four native viewport views cover both sizes, both banks, sun, shade and a 64-inch player-height camera
observations: Open slots show the recessed well and lower transverse supports instead of a flat surface-level backing plate.
Beveled frame edges and the cast-iron surface remain visible in sun and shade.
The paving ends at the frame without covering the open slots on either bank.
No missing materials or obvious surface overlap is visible in these four views.
limits: Static editor visual review, not a gameplay performance or temporal-filtering measurement. Does not establish overall AAA map quality.
